policy: Fill only currently empty bilingual etiology fields for four musculoskeletal Conditions. Preserve existing pathology, risk factors, red flags, acupuncture scope, relations, and provenance; append direct government or NHS sources. Explicitly distinguish disease mechanisms from normal aging, risk factors, and similarly named disorders.

cond.pseudogout.etiology_zh: CPPD 源於焦磷酸鈣晶體在關節軟骨、纖維軟骨或滑膜周圍沉積；晶體脫落到關節腔並啟動先天免疫發炎時，才出現急性 CPP 晶體關節炎（舊稱假性痛風）。晶體生成與軟骨細胞周圍無機焦磷酸濃度及鈣化環境改變有關，最常見於老年且常無可辨識的單一原因。較早或廣泛發病時應考慮家族性易感、既往關節損傷，以及血色素沉著症、甲狀旁腺功能亢進、低鎂血症或低磷酸酶症等代謝背景。X 光軟骨鈣化可以沒有症狀；本病晶體是 calcium pyrophosphate，不是痛風的 monosodium urate。
cond.pseudogout.etiology_en: CPPD begins with deposition of calcium pyrophosphate crystals in articular cartilage, fibrocartilage, or peri-synovial tissues. Acute CPP crystal arthritis (formerly pseudogout) occurs when crystals shed into the joint and trigger innate inflammatory pathways. Crystal formation is linked to altered extracellular inorganic pyrophosphate and a cartilage environment that favors mineralization; it is most common with aging and often has no single identifiable cause. Earlier-onset or extensive disease should prompt consideration of familial susceptibility, prior joint injury, and metabolic settings such as hemochromatosis, hyperparathyroidism, hypomagnesemia, or hypophosphatasia. Radiographic chondrocalcinosis may be asymptomatic, and CPP crystals are distinct from the monosodium urate crystals of gout.

etiology_zh: NCBI StatPearls: Calcium Pyrophosphate Deposition Disease — crystal formation, aging, familial and metabolic associations (retrieved 2026-08); University Hospitals Bristol NHS: Gout and pseudogout — CPPD distinction and asymptomatic calcification (retrieved 2026-08)
etiology_en: NCBI StatPearls: Calcium Pyrophosphate Deposition Disease — crystal formation, aging, familial and metabolic associations (retrieved 2026-08); University Hospitals Bristol NHS: Gout and pseudogout — CPPD distinction and asymptomatic calcification (retrieved 2026-08)

cond.sarcopenia.etiology_zh: 肌少症是終生累積的不利肌肉變化造成的肌力與肌量／品質下降，病因通常為多因素。原發性肌少症以老化相關的運動單位流失、合成代謝反應降低、荷爾蒙與神經肌肉接點改變、低度發炎及粒線體功能變化等共同作用；活動不足與蛋白質或總熱量攝取不足會加速下降。慢性心肺、腎臟、內分泌或發炎疾病、癌症、住院與長期臥床可造成或加重次發性肌少症。年齡相關肌肉下降雖常見，但達到影響力量與功能的肌少症不是應被視為不可避免且無法介入的「正常老化」，也須與 cachexia 及特定神經肌肉病區分。
cond.sarcopenia.etiology_en: Sarcopenia reflects adverse muscle changes accumulated across the life course, with declining strength and muscle quantity or quality, and is usually multifactorial. Primary age-related sarcopenia involves interacting loss of motor units, anabolic resistance, hormonal and neuromuscular-junction changes, low-grade inflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction; inactivity and inadequate protein or energy intake accelerate decline. Chronic cardiopulmonary, renal, endocrine, or inflammatory disease, cancer, hospitalization, and prolonged bed rest can cause or worsen secondary sarcopenia. Although some muscle loss accompanies aging, function-limiting sarcopenia should not be dismissed as inevitable, nonmodifiable “normal aging,” and it must be distinguished from cachexia and specific neuromuscular disease.

etiology_zh: NCBI StatPearls: Sarcopenia — age-related, metabolic, inflammatory, nutritional, and inactivity mechanisms (retrieved 2026-08); EWGSOP2 consensus, Age and Ageing/PMC — primary versus secondary causes and life-course muscle failure (2019)
etiology_en: NCBI StatPearls: Sarcopenia — age-related, metabolic, inflammatory, nutritional, and inactivity mechanisms (retrieved 2026-08); EWGSOP2 consensus, Age and Ageing/PMC — primary versus secondary causes and life-course muscle failure (2019)

cond.generalized_osteoarthritis.etiology_zh: 骨關節炎的起始觸發因子尚未完全確定，並非單純把關節「用壞」。軟骨、軟骨下骨、滑膜、半月板、韌帶與肌肉之間的修復與分解失衡，會逐步改變整個關節器官；受傷後排列或力學改變、發育性關節形態、重複過載、肥胖相關機械與代謝效應、年齡及遺傳易感均可參與。所謂全身性骨關節炎是多個典型關節部位同時或先後受累的表型，可能較受全身性遺傳與生物因素影響，但各關節仍有自己的局部負荷與舊傷機轉。影像退化可無痛，不能把多處 X 光變化自動當作所有疼痛的共同原因。
cond.generalized_osteoarthritis.etiology_en: The initiating trigger of osteoarthritis is not fully defined, and the disease is not simply a joint being “worn out.” Imbalance between repair and breakdown across cartilage, subchondral bone, synovium, menisci, ligaments, and muscle gradually alters the whole joint organ. Post-injury alignment or mechanics, developmental joint shape, repetitive overload, mechanical and metabolic effects of obesity, aging, and genetic susceptibility can all contribute. Generalized osteoarthritis is a phenotype involving multiple characteristic joint sites simultaneously or sequentially and may carry stronger systemic genetic or biologic influence, while each joint still has its own local loading and injury history. Radiographic degeneration may be painless and should not automatically be treated as the common source of every pain site.

etiology_zh: NIAMS: Osteoarthritis — whole-joint tissue breakdown, unknown initiating trigger, and risk contributors (last reviewed 2023-09); NHS: Osteoarthritis — repair failure, secondary joint damage, age, family and obesity factors (last reviewed 2023-03-20)
etiology_en: NIAMS: Osteoarthritis — whole-joint tissue breakdown, unknown initiating trigger, and risk contributors (last reviewed 2023-09); NHS: Osteoarthritis — repair failure, secondary joint damage, age, family and obesity factors (last reviewed 2023-03-20)

cond.myositis.etiology_zh: 「肌炎」是肌肉發炎的一組異質性疾病名稱，不能用單一病因概括。皮肌炎、多發性肌炎與免疫介導壞死性肌病主要屬免疫介導性疾病，遺傳易感者可能在環境暴露、感染或藥物（包括少數 statin 相關免疫介導壞死性肌病）後啟動自體免疫；確切觸發仍常未知。包涵體肌炎另有退化與蛋白質聚積機轉，且治療反應不同。感染、毒物或藥物也可造成次發性肌肉發炎或肌病，臨床上須與內分泌、代謝、遺傳性肌病及單純藥物性肌毒性區分；因此診斷應先確定具體亞型，而不是把所有肌痛或 CK 升高都稱為同一種 myositis。
cond.myositis.etiology_en: “Myositis” is a heterogeneous family of inflammatory muscle disorders and has no single etiology. Dermatomyositis, polymyositis, and immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy are primarily immune-mediated; in a genetically susceptible person, environmental exposure, infection, or medication—including uncommon statin-triggered immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy—may initiate autoimmunity, although the trigger often remains unknown. Inclusion body myositis also has degenerative and protein-aggregation mechanisms and a different treatment response. Infection, toxins, or drugs can produce secondary muscle inflammation or myopathy and must be distinguished from endocrine, metabolic, inherited, and direct toxic myopathies. Diagnosis therefore requires a specific subtype rather than labeling every myalgia or creatine-kinase elevation as one form of myositis.

etiology_zh: NIAMS Muscle Disease Section — autoimmune myositis subtypes and environmental or medication triggers (retrieved 2026-08); NCBI StatPearls: Polymyositis — immune-mediated and heterogeneous inflammatory-myopathy causes (retrieved 2026-08)
etiology_en: NIAMS Muscle Disease Section — autoimmune myositis subtypes and environmental or medication triggers (retrieved 2026-08); NCBI StatPearls: Polymyositis — immune-mediated and heterogeneous inflammatory-myopathy causes (retrieved 2026-08)
